tools.name: size_guide
tools.description: Estimate clothing sizes from height, weight and body type, with each store's size chart link. Returns US/UK/EU dress sizes and letter sizes. An estimate only; always check the store's own chart. Computed server-side, nothing stored.

tools.name: find_dress_by_length
tools.description: Find mini, midi or maxi dresses for an occasion, size and budget. Returns 3-6 picks with a one-line reason and links to live searches at Etsy, Nordstrom, ASOS and other stores. Prices are estimates; checkout happens on the store's site.

tools.name: shop_search
tools.description: Describe who you're shopping for in one sentence (who, occasion, size, budget, things to avoid). Returns 3-6 fashion picks across dresses, tops, outerwear, jewelry, bags and menswear, each with a reason and links to live searches at multiple stores. Nothing is bought here.

tools.name: gift_basket_concierge
tools.description: Describe the recipient in one sentence (who, occasion, what they love, dietary needs, budget). Returns the best-fitting gift basket styles with a reason each and links to buy from partner retailers.

tools.name: scarf_concierge
tools.description: Describe the recipient in one sentence (who, colors, fabric, climate, budget, monogram). Returns scarf style ideas with a reason each and links to live searches of real scarves from independent makers.
